hooks.command: sh -c 'top="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}"; [ -n "$top" ] || top="$(git rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree 2>/dev/null)"; [ -n "$top" ] || top="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; f="$top/.harness/.agents/hooks/git-guard.mjs"; [ -f "$f" ] || { echo "harness: submodule uninitialized - run: git submodule update --init" >&2; exit 2; }; exec node "$f"'
